data.name: MS Milenium Monterrey, Curio Collection by Hilton
data.address: Ave Jose Vasconcelos, San Agustín 300-Ote Residencial, 66260 San Pedro Garza García, N.L., Mexico
data.description:
Occupying a striking modern building facing the Sierra Madre mountains, this upscale hotel is 5 km from the Museo de Arte Contemporáneo de Monterrey, and 6 km from Macroplaza's fountains and gardens.
Warm rooms with mountain views provide Wi-Fi access and flat-screens, as well as minibars, sitting areas, and tea and coffeemakers. Suites add living rooms and kitchenettes; upgraded 2-bedroom suites have whirlpool tubs. Some quarters offer access to a lounge with food, drinks and other perks. There's room service.
There's a steakhouse and a casual eatery, plus a gym, 2 pools (indoor and outdoor), a tennis court and conference facilities.
